description: Deterministic synthetic classroom prices, not actual market quotes or Efin data. DEMO_* symbols do not identify investable securities.
source: Original formula-generated demonstration data for efin-dashboard-starter. No external market feed was used.
calendar: 90 weekdays; Thai market holidays are not modeled.
priceType: Synthetic unadjusted close; no dividends, corporate actions or fees.

generation.priceFormula: round(base * exp(drift * i) * (1 + amplitude * sin(i / 7 + phase)), 2)
generation.index: i = 0 through 89 in chronological weekday order
